I can't provide real-time weather updates, but you can check the current weather in your area using:

- **Weather websites**: [Weather.com](https://weather.com), [AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com), or [The Weather Channel](https://weather.com).
- **Search engines**: Type *"weather in [your city]"* on Google.
- **Weather apps**: Apple Weather, Google Weather, or apps like **Windy** or **The Weather Channel**.

Would you like help finding a forecast for a specific location? Let me know! ☀️🌧️❄️
